labels.label: implied
labels.why: Reusing assignment events is requested ("notified as for a single assignment"), and a durable outbox keeps the escalation notification from being lost on restart while still honouring "escalated at most once, even across restarts", so urgent tickets do not silently wait.

labels.label: requested
labels.why: "A ticket is escalated at most once, even across restarts of the service"; loading legacy data without the marker only keeps "Everything the service already does keeps working".

labels.label: implied
labels.why: Without serialized store operations, bulk reassignment racing with single assignment or the escalation worker could move or escalate tickets inconsistently and corrupt the reported moved count and ids.

labels.label: beyond
labels.why: Logging worker failures is implied so failed escalations are not hidden, but an assignment audit trail and an outbox report add an audit log and reporting surface the request does not ask for.

labels.label: requested
